title: LadderRecord
description: What the population ladder decided in one generation and why (ADR-021 sections 4, 6, 8): frozen anchor strengths, member and snapshot strengths with bootstrap bounds, the pair-score table by member and opponent, the cyclic-triple count, the selection outcomes and each member's effective settings and root. Integers only; strengths are never computed here (the record only holds them). Reader rules the profile cannot say (sorted and unique lists, table counts that agree with their sums, lower at most upper, anchors fixed across generations when the previous record is given, at most one copy, roots counted from the members) are checked by the TS and Python readers. Referenced only by the SHA-256 of its JCS bytes.

run_config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the run's TrainingRunConfig JCS bytes.

anchors.description: Frozen anchor strengths, sorted by anchor_id, each once; actor-rule@v1 is present at exactly 1000000000.

members.description: The learning members, sorted by member, each once.

snapshots.description: Past-pool snapshots with frozen strengths, sorted by snapshot_id, each once.

cells.description: The pair-score table, sorted by member, then opponent kind, then opponent id, each once.

cyclic_triples.description: Triples of current members where A beats B, B beats C and C beats A, each with a one-sided lower bound above 500000 ppm. Reader rule: at most C(members, 3).

selections.description: The generation's decisions. The first is the copy test's outcome (copy or none), the rest are health replacements sorted by member, each member once; so there is at most one copy.

Strength.description: A strength on the ladder's scale (10^9 for the reference anchor) with the percentile bootstrap bounds the selection step reads (ADR-021 section 4). Reader rule: lower_ppm... lower <= upper.

lower.description: Lower bootstrap bound on the same scale.

upper.description: Upper bootstrap bound on the same scale.

Anchor.description: A fixed outside reference. Its strength is fitted once by the generation-0 calibration and frozen for the run.

strength.description: Frozen strength, scale 10^9; actor-rule@v1 is 10^9 by definition.

Shares.description: A member's opponent shares in parts per million of its policy seats (ADR-021 section 3). Reader rule: the three add up to 1000000.

MemberSettings.description: A member's effective PPO settings and opponent shares (ADR-021 sections 6, 8): integers only.

target_kl_micro.description: Absent when the run sets no target KL.

Member.description: A learning member as the state at the decision, before the copy: its strength, the generation-0 member it descends from and its effective settings.

root.description: The generation-0 member this slot's weights descend from (copies inherit the donor's root).

Snapshot.description: A frozen pair in the past pool whose strength was frozen at entry once it had n_min pairs (ADR-021 section 4).

snapshot_id.description: <member>@g<generation>. Reader rule: equals the member and generation fields.

generation.description: The generation the snapshot was frozen at.

Window.description: The generations whose results the ratings and the decision read (ADR-021 section 4). Reader rules: last_generation equals the record's generation; first_generation is max(1, generation - size + 1).

Opponent.description: Who a cell's member played: another member, a past-pool snapshot or an anchor.

id.description: A member id, a snapshot id or an anchor policy id, by kind. Reader rule: it resolves in this record.

Cell.description: The pair results of one member against one opponent in the window. A pair score is the mean of two games and is 0, 250000, 500000, 750000 or 1000000 ppm, so scores counts the pairs at each. Reader rules: pairs is the sum of scores, score_sum_ppm is 250000 times (scores[1] + 2 scores[2] + 3 scores[3] + 4 scores[4]).

NoSelection.description: No copy this generation, with the first condition of ADR-021 figure 2 that failed.

Copy.description: The copy step (ADR-021 figure 2): the loser's slot takes the donor's weights and Adam moments. Reader rules: loser differs from donor, both are members, and the donor has the highest strength; pairs equals the donor-against-loser cell's pairs; lower_bound_ppm is above 500000 plus margin_ppm; each anchor minimum is the least floor(score_sum_ppm / pairs) over that member's anchor cells; the donor's is not below the loser's; the donor's strength is at least every member's; roots_before and roots_after are the distinct roots of the members before the copy and after the loser's root becomes the donor's.

margin_ppm.description: The selection margin the test used (population.selection.margin_ppm). Reader rule: lower_bound_ppm is above 500000 plus margin_ppm.

lower_bound_ppm.description: One-sided bootstrap lower bound of the donor's mean pair score against the loser.

learner_seed_index.description: The index of the population-seed/1 draw (purpose member-learner) that seeds the slot's new learner generator.

Health.description: A quarantined member whose slot is replaced by a copy of the top member without the statistical test (ADR-021 section 6).
